message: Approved: a 5-hour hackathon for 120 students in teams of 4. Total budget Rs 520,000. Eight volunteers will help on the day and must be fed too.
Lotus Room seats 140 at Rs 70,000 (no projector). Cedar Hall seats 180 at Rs 95,000 and has a projector. The Atrium seats 260 at Rs 160,000 with projector and generator.
The venue must have a projector for the final demos.
AoA! Biryani box Rs 900 per head, sandwich box Rs 600. 12 vegetarian boxes bhi chahiye honge, veg box ka rate bhi Rs 900 hai.
14 judges confirmed at Rs 4,000 each. Each team needs 12 minutes and no judge should see more than 3 teams.
Already paid from the budget: trophies Rs 45,000 and T-shirts Rs 60,000.
A security fee of Rs 15,000 is mandatory. The event must finish by 17:00.
Can we have a photo booth? Rs 25,000 only.
Start at 11:30 please, and keep a 20-minute Asr prayer break at 15:30.
Anyone up for a match on Sunday?
